purpose: Empirical memory scaling of three gradient methods on Deucalion; no training
backend: PennyLane default.qubit for all methods; torch interface; native internal kernels can differ by method
precision: complex128 state, float64 angles and output
circuit: For i=0..groups-1: a=i%n,b=(i+1)%n; RY(theta[3i],a), RX(theta[3i+1],b), CNOT(a,b), RY(theta[3i+2],b), CNOT(b,a). Initial |0>, scalar expectation of Pauli Z on wire 0 (constant 2x2 observable matrix).
angles: NumPy default_rng seed uniform[-1,1], one vector per group count; identical across methods/qubits/repeats
execution: Fresh interpreter for each case, sequential methods and shifts, no broadcasting or multiprocessing; one active compute core, one exclusive 48-core A64FX node
memory: Linux VmRSS baseline after tiny 2-qubit method warmup, circuit construction, gc and malloc_trim; reset own VmHWM via clear_refs=5; measure full value+gradient; report absolute VmHWM and increment above baseline. External 10ms RSS samples and lifetime ru_maxrss retained.
limitations: RSS includes quantum buffers, framework temporaries and allocator effects; subtraction is not exact live tensor accounting
Fixed-gate qubit sweep tests exponential-in-n scaling, not gate-depth scaling alone
Depth subtest checks direction and size of gate-dependent retention at fixed n
Previously stated 103/3/1 vector counts are illustrative, not universal backend predictions
No multi-node or hardware execution; memory results cannot establish distributed backend support
hypotheses: One dense statevector is S=16*2^n bytes
Uncheckpointed reverse-mode backprop retains gate-dependent intermediates, O(G*S)
Reversible adjoint uses O(S) state memory for serial scalar observable, implementation-dependent constant
Sequential parameter-shift uses O(S) state memory, with computation proportional to number of shifted evaluations
production_gate: Only submit after all 8 smoke runs pass, observed memory and runtime support the 2-hour bound; otherwise investigate without expanding resource bounds automatically
analysis: Median and range of 3 repetitions; all raw runs retained. Compare peak and incremental RSS vs S. Fit intercept+slope*S to n14..20 separately for each method, report residuals and ratios; do not infer asymptotic proof from small cases.
revision: Second smoke found default.qubit adjoint densifies global parity to a 2^n by 2^n matrix (64GiB allocation at n16). All methods now use local Z0; prior attempts preserved. No production measurements yet.
